interpretation_boundary: This ledger tests QM-readiness of a reduced classical link model. v0.3.3 uses fixed physical self-exclusion arcs and D-dimensionalized energy terms, but a separate N-continuum audit is still required before closure comparisons. It does not derive Born probabilities, Hilbert space, hbar, operator commutators, or empirical particle spectra.
